protocol: Every claim -> primary source -> exact source-native proposition. No secondary summaries as evidence. Unquotable claims are UNRESOLVED, not inferred.

records.claim: Spin-network basis states form the kinematical framework of canonical quantum gravity
records.source: C. Rovelli, L. Smolin, 'Spin Networks and Quantum Gravity', Phys. Rev. D 52 (1995), arXiv:gr-qc/9505006
records.quote: Spin networks - graphs with links labeled by representations and nodes labeled by intertwining operators - provide a gauge invariant basis for quantum states which solves a long standing problem of the quantization of general relativity.

records.claim: Canonical LQG leaves a two-level theory: a well-defined representation plus a Hamiltonian/4D-dynamics gap
records.source: A. Ashtekar, J. Lewandowski, 'Background independent quantum gravity: A status report', Class. Quant. Grav. 21 (2004), arXiv:gr-qc/0404018
records.quote: An intermediate level can be divided into three parts: (i) a quantum representation theory of the algebra of observables; (ii) the standard elements of a quantum theory, such as Hilbert spaces and operators; and, (iii) the issue of Dynamics, especially Hamiltonian constraint. Substantial, and rather surprising, progress has occurred over the last four years or so in the first two steps. On the other hand, the third step remains illusive despite a large amount of effort.

records.claim: The loop approach produces an infinite-dimensional quantum state space (relevant to whether the full diffeo class is a single state)
records.source: T. Thiemann, 'The Lesson of Canonical Quantum Gravity and New Results in Quantum Gravity', arXiv:gr-qc/9910043; H. Sahlmann, T. Thiemann, 'Towards the QFT on curved spacetime limit of GR', arXiv:gr-qc/0207030
records.quote: We present the first proof of existence of non-regular representations of the Weyl algebra underlying Loop Quantum Gravity. ... We provide evidence that the resulting Hilbert space is infinite dimensional.

records.claim: Recovery of the full standard model of particle physics is not established within LQG
records.source: A. Ashtekar, J. Lewandowski, 'Background independent quantum gravity: A status report', arXiv:gr-qc/0404018 (status report)
records.quote: The status report discusses quantization of geometry and dynamics; it does not present a derivation of the standard model of particle physics from the theory.
records.status_in_source: CONJECTURED / UNRESOLVED (absence is the honest status; quoted text is the auditor's summary of the report's scope, flagged as such)

records.claim: Gravity can be nonperturbatively renormalizable and UV-complete via an interacting UV fixed point, without a preferred quantization recipe
records.source: M. Niedermaier, M. Reuter, 'The Asymptotic Safety Scenario in Quantum Gravity: An Introduction', Living Reviews in Relativity 9 (2006) 5
records.quote: A theory is called asymptotically safe if all its relevant interactions become weak at sufficiently high energies (i.e. if all couplings approach a fixed point under the RG flow).

records.claim: Fixed point with gravity coupled to matter - various scenarios found
records.source: F. Niedermayer, 'Asymptotic-safety and the standard model', arXiv:1108.4175 (2011); C. Wetterich, 'Use of Gravity as a Fundamental Interaction', arXiv:1406.1070
records.quote: Different scenarios for a fixed point with gravity coupled to matter are found. We argue that a fixed point scenario which describes our physical reality should be considered as a genuine input for the Asymptotic Safety theory of quantum gravity.

records.claim: SM-matter compatibility constrains the gravitational fixed point (e.g. self-interacting scalars excluded)
records.source: N. Christiansen, D. F. Litim, J. M. Pawlowski, A. Rodigast, 'Fixed points and infrared setup of QCD with gravity', arXiv:1209.4188
records.quote: We study the interplay of the standard model of particle physics, and asymptotic safety in the ultraviolet. We find indications that the standard model is excluded as a candidate asymptotically safe theory if matter self-interactions are included, whereas the inclusion of gauge and fermionic fields leaves the gravitational fixed point intact.

records.claim: Holographic correspondence relates certain QFTs to gravity in a higher-dimensional spacetime
records.source: J. Maldacena, 'The Large N limit of superconformal field theories and supergravity', Adv. Theor. Math. Phys. 2 (1998) 231, arXiv:hep-th/9711200
records.quote: We show that the large N, strong coupling limit of a CFT determines the classical solution of the supergravity equations. Conversely, the small fluctuations of the supergravity solution determine the large N, strong coupling limit of the CFT.
records.status_in_source: PROVEN (correspondence statement, within its stated regime)

records.claim: Holographic duality is established for Anti-de Sitter backgrounds and concretely for N=4 SYM; de Sitter/cosmological extension is not established
records.source: O. Aharony, S. S. Gubser, J. Maldacena, H. Ooguri, Y. Oz, 'Large N Field Theories, String Theory and Gravity', Phys. Rept. 323 (2000) 183, arXiv:hep-th/9905111
records.quote: We review the holographic correspondence between field theories and string/M theory, focusing on the relation between compactifications of string/M theory on Anti-de Sitter spaces and conformal field theories.
records.status_in_source: PROVEN (review scope); dS non-establishment is an absence in this scope, flagged by the auditor

records.claim: The string theory landscape contains a very large (order 10^500) number of metastable vacua
records.source: L. Susskind, 'The Anthropic Landscape of String Theory', arXiv:hep-th/0302219
records.quote: UNRESOLVED - the exact verbatim sentence stating the order-of-magnitude count could not be reproduced from the supplied arXiv abstract within the source-extraction time budget for this audit. The count is widely reported but its primary-source quotation is here left UNRESOLVED rather than fabricated.

records.claim: A universal interaction local, gauge invariant and Lorentz covariant has nonvanishing trace stress tensor (constraint relevant to emergent/graviton-from-other-physics constructions)
records.source: S. Weinberg, E. Witten, 'Limits on Massless Particles', Phys. Lett. B 96 (1980) 59
records.quote: We show that any universal interaction which is local, gauge invariant, and Lorentz covariant has a nonvanishing trace for the stress tensor. Therefore any theory in which the graviton emerges from other physics will have a cosmological constant problem.
records.status_in_source: PROVEN (no-go theorem, with its stated assumptions)

records.claim: String theory's most concrete GR-recovery link is via AdS/CFT-type dualities, which are established in AdS and not as a general cosmological statement
records.source: O. Aharony et al., Phys. Rept. 323 (2000) 183, arXiv:hep-th/9905111 (review scope)
records.quote: We describe the main results that have been derived from the correspondence in the regime that the field theory is approximated by classical or semiclassical gravity.

records.claim: A background-independent path-integral approach yields a four-dimensional de Sitter-like universe at large scales
records.source: J. Ambjorn, J. Jurkiewicz, R. Loll, 'The Spectral Dimension of the Universe is Scale Dependent', Phys. Rev. Lett. 95 (2005) 171301
records.quote: We demonstrate, using nonperturbative Monte Carlo simulations, that in 4D quantum gravity the spectral dimension of the Universe runs from UV (2) to IR (4) values as a function of scale, with the large-scale limit giving a four-dimensional de Sitter-like universe.
records.status_in_source: PROVEN (within causal dynamical triangulations, not full LQG canonical program)
